_comment: 🧩️ ZIP 2.0/✳️base's own contribution to the repository test platform — its mutation oracle registration and its declared mutation vocabulary (wave 7, ticket 26/08/23/END-TO-END-TESTING-REFACTOR). Discovered by convention alongside ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio's own top-level manifest; merged into one registry, no central edit required.

oracles.rationale:
🩹️ RECLASSIFIED (ticket SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION, shard A10, 2026-09-02). This entry was registered `third-party-library` on the strength of a real crate that does genuine codec work, but the mutation's expected RESULT is computed by this owner's own `🦀️oracle.rs` -- its dispatch function's catch-all arm is `"mutation kind {...} has no oracle implementation"`, proof that every OTHER arm is an implementation, not a reading. Both halves of the comparison then descend from the same specification, so a shared misreading produces two agreeing wrong answers -- the one failure a differential oracle exists to catch. This is a `cross-semio-implementation`: a required SUPPLEMENT (metamorphic/inverse/round-trip evidence), never a substitute. A qualifying third-party reference for the mutation semantics is still owed. See $TICKET/📓️a10-oracle-honesty.md.

The reference ZIP reader/writer of the Rust ecosystem, driven here through the full add/remove/rename/set-data/set-comment/set-snapshot mutation vocabulary this subset declares, with the archive-level comment kept live (never ignored) so `set-archive-comment` is a real, checked mutation and not a no-op. Distinct id and capability from the top-level `zip` entry's `zip-archive` (plain create/read/remove-member evidence): reusing that entry outside its surveyed capability would fail the contract's oracle-capability-mismatch check, and a mutation vocabulary belongs to the subset that declares it, not to the format generally.

comparisonProfiles.description: ZIP archives compared as a SET of members by name, uncompressed size and content digest, PLUS the archive-level comment as a normative field. Entry order, compression method and level, timestamps, attributes and the extra field remain writer freedom. Differs from the base `semantic-archive-v1` profile only in that `comment` is NOT ignored: this subset's vocabulary declares `set-archive-comment` as one of its mutation kinds, so the comment has to actually participate in the comparison for that mutation to be a checked test rather than a no-op.
